result.edit: The test fails at cycle=9 with incorrect Gray code output (0110 vs expected 0111). The issue is in the Gray-to-binary conversion where blocking assignments (=) cause incorrect intermediate values to propagate immediately. Changing to non-blocking assignments (<=) ensures correct sequential evaluation. Also fixed the AND operation to XOR for proper Gray code conversion. This maintains the 2-cycle increment requirement while producing correct Gray code sequence.
